title: StartLux-Decision: AutoThink Decision Models with Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2610.17309v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD$^2$), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. translated_title: StartLux-Decision：基于强化学习的AutoThink决策模型，实现校准的审慎决策
translated_abstract: 我们推出了StartLux-Decision，这是一系列参数规模从0.8B到27B的决策模型，将高效的单次预测与自适应的、置信度引导的推理相结合。Instant模型在完整注意力层中使用双向注意力来提升决策精度，同时保持单次推理。AutoThink模型则对不确定的决策调用显式推理，而对有把握的案例直接给出答案。三阶段训练流程先建立共享的决策能力，再将两个变体专门化，并通过推理监督和强化学习为AutoThink配备推理能力。我们提出了用于校准审慎决策的强化学习方法（RLCD²），该方法使用一个冻结模型和适当的评分规则来奖励决策概率质量的提升，并对过长的推理轨迹施加软惩罚。RLCD²提高了在生成限制内终止的推理轨迹的比例……
tldr: 该论文提出StartLux-Decision系列决策模型（0.8B至27B参数），通过置信度引导的自适应推理机制与全新的RLCD²强化学习方法（利用冻结模型和适当评分规则奖励校准的决策概率质量、惩罚过长推理），实现了高效单次预测与按需深度推理的结合。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces StartLux-Decision, a family of decision models (0.8B–27B) that combine efficient single-pass prediction with confidence-guided adaptive reasoning, trained via RLCD², a novel reinforcement learning method that uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to improve calibrated decision quality while penalizing overlong reasoning traces.
